name: 場所：建築
summary: 建築物：銀行、學校、醫院、商店。

phrases.en: between the bank and the post office
phrases.ipa: bɪˈtwiːn ðə bæŋk ən ðə pəʊst ˈɒf.ɪs

phrases.en: take the lift to the fifth floor
phrases.ipa: teɪk ðə lɪft tə ðə fɪfθ flɔː

sentences.en: The museum is opposite the railway station.
sentences.zh: 博物館在火車站對面。

sentences.en: Turn left at the bank and walk straight on.
sentences.zh: 在銀行左轉然後直走。

sentences.en: We met our friends in front of the cinema.
sentences.zh: 我們在電影院前面碰到朋友。

sentences.en: Children love the swimming pool in our hotel.
sentences.zh: 孩子們很喜歡旅館的游泳池。

sentences.en: My mum buys fresh bread at the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 我媽會去超市買新鮮麵包。

sentences.en: The police station is just past the post office.
sentences.zh: 警察局就在郵局過去一點。

sentences.en: There is a small cafe next to the library.
sentences.zh: 圖書館旁邊有一間小咖啡館。

sentences.en: The hospital is between the school and the bank.
sentences.zh: 醫院在學校和銀行之間。

sentences.en: The entrance is on the left of the building.
sentences.zh: 入口在建築物的左邊。

sentences.en: He works in a big factory on the edge of town.
sentences.zh: 他在城鎮邊緣的大工廠工作。

sentences.en: We took a photo in front of the castle.
sentences.zh: 我們在城堡前拍了張照片。

sentences.en: The department store opens at ten every morning.
sentences.zh: 百貨公司每天早上十點開門。

sentences.en: My sister studies at the college in our town.
sentences.zh: 我姊姊在城鎮裡的學院讀書。

sentences.en: Is there a pharmacy near the hotel?
sentences.zh: 旅館附近有藥局嗎？

tips: 特指某一個場所時前面用 the，例如 I like the shop on my street；泛指或第一次提到用 a，例如 There is a shop near here。
英式樓層怎麼說：ground floor 是一樓，first floor 是二樓，second floor 是三樓。
英式樓層怎麼說：ground floor 是一樓，往上依序是 first floor、second floor。

name: 場所：郊野
summary: 野外的地方：山、河、森林、海邊。

sentences.en: We walked up the hill to see the view.
sentences.zh: 我們走上小山去看風景。

sentences.en: Our village is up in the mountains, far from the city.
sentences.zh: 我們的村莊在山裡，離市區很遠。

sentences.en: Children are playing football in the field near the river.
sentences.zh: 孩子們在河邊的田地裡踢足球。

sentences.en: We had lunch on the grass by the lake.
sentences.zh: 我們在湖邊的草地上吃午餐。

sentences.en: We followed the path through the forest for an hour.
sentences.zh: 我們沿著小徑穿過森林走了一小時。

sentences.en: My grandparents live in a house beside the farm.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父母住在農場旁邊的房子裡。

sentences.en: The sea was cold, but the beach was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 海很冷，不過海灘很漂亮。

sentences.en: It is very quiet in the countryside at night.
sentences.zh: 郊區的夜晚非常安靜。

sentences.en: The sky is very clear above the hills tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚山丘上方的天空很晴朗。

sentences.en: The railway goes through the valley to the coast.
sentences.zh: 鐵路穿過山谷通往海岸。

sentences.en: There is a campsite on the island for tourists.
sentences.zh: 島上有給旅客使用的露營地。

sentences.en: We found an interesting cave under the cliff.
sentences.zh: 我們在懸崖下發現一個有趣的洞穴。

sentences.en: Rain falls in the rainforest every single day.
sentences.zh: 雨林裡每天都在下雨。

sentences.en: We climbed the mountain and looked at the ocean.
sentences.zh: 我們爬上了山，然後看著大海。

tips: 郊野位置多用介系詞：in the countryside 在郊區、on the beach 在海灘上、in the forest 在森林裡。
方向詞放在 the 後面：up the hill 是往上爬，down the path 是沿小路往下走。
泛稱自然景觀時不加 the，指特定地方才加，例如 we can see the mountain。
